jobs.title: Business Analyst / Salesforce Administrator
jobs.location: New York, NY — Financial District; hybrid Tue–Thu in office
jobs.why: Direct match to Orion Salesforce BA/admin work: fields and layouts, Flows, validation rules, Data Loader, reports/dashboards, data hygiene, UAT, requirements and user training for 200+ users. Employer requires 2 years of BA experience; Audrey has Jan 2024–Apr 2026.
jobs.gap: Salesforce enrollment/lottery domain, Marketing Cloud and Service Cloud depth, assignment rules/snapshot reporting and formal Salesforce certifications are not evidenced; certifications are recommended rather than required.

jobs.title: Product Operations Manager
jobs.location: New York City — hybrid (employer also mentions flexible remote/hybrid)
jobs.salary: $90,000–$120,000 in posting compensation field; body says $75,000–$100,000 — conflicting employer figures; confirm before applying
jobs.why: Strong transfer from Orion's release notes, cross-functional UAT and rollout coordination, Knowledge documentation and training library, reporting, and operational process improvement. The job emphasizes creating launch playbooks and making product delivery repeatable rather than owning product strategy.
jobs.gap: Formal product operations and feature-launch ownership, OKR planning, post-release product analytics and AI-agent-ready knowledge-base information architecture are not established. Employer posting contains inconsistent salary ranges.
